units.source_text: 為了逃出地獄，我使出了最後一招，如果這一招也以失敗告終，那就只能自縊懸樑了。

en.t: In order to escape from hell, I resorted to my final measure; if even this ended in failure, all that remained was to hang myself.

units.source_text: 我把神的存在作為賭注，鼓起勇氣給家裡的老父親寫了一封長信，

en.t: Staking everything on the existence of God, I summoned my courage and wrote a long letter to my elderly father back home,

units.source_text: 向他坦白了我目前的真實情況（關於女人的事，我最終還是沒敢寫進信裡）。

en.t: confessing to him the truth of my present situation (though in the end I still could not bring myself to write about the woman).

units.source_text: 可是，結果更糟糕，左等右盼一直杳無音信，等待的焦慮與不安，反而讓我又加大了藥量。

en.t: But the result was even worse: no matter how long I waited, no word came, and the anxiety and unease of waiting instead made me increase the dosage again.

units.source_text: 今晚，乾脆一次連續注射十針，然後跳進隅田川一死了之。

en.t: Tonight, I would simply inject ten shots in a row all at once, then jump into the Sumida River and end it.

units.source_text: 就在我這樣暗暗下決心的下午，比目魚就像有惡魔的直覺一樣嗅出了我的念頭，帶著堀木出現在我的面前。

en.t: On the afternoon when I had secretly made up my mind to do this, Flatfish, as if he had scented out my thoughts with a devil's intuition, appeared before me with Horiki.
